title: Three models join the text API
summary:
Three models joined the text API, three community projects joined the lists, and the speech request example got its parameters in the right places.

Added `openai-reasoning` with text and image input, `llama-vision`, and `gemini` using Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview. The `openai` and `openai-large` aliases now point to GPT-4.1 nano and GPT-4.1 mini, respectively; the same update also adjusted model routing and prompts.

The project lists gained DesmondBot, a snarky Llama-based chat bot; OkeyAI, which focuses on African languages and cultural contexts; and BlackWave, which generates images from text prompts.

The text-to-speech POST docs now show `modalities: ["text", "audio"]` and put `voice` and `format` in an `audio` object. The parameter table was updated to match.

highlights.title: Reasoning with image input
highlights.text: Try `openai-reasoning`, backed by o4-mini, with text and image input. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-reasoning).

highlights.title: Llama gets vision
highlights.text: Use `llama-vision` for image-aware requests with Llama 3.2 11B Vision. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=llama-vision).

highlights.title: Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview
highlights.text: Try Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview through the `gemini` model ID. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini).
